title: Kenworth T608 FUPS Road Train Bullbar #35
description: Kenworth T608 FUPS Road Train hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar. Lower cow catcher bar at the base of the main channel with 5 small cow catchers. 88mm pipe with an additional lower tube in front of the grille plus a full width additional cross pipe above headlights. All cross pipes are recessed into the drilled uprights, no butt welds. The heavy duty box uprights extend across the main channel to the cow catcher bar for maximum strength and protection. Flip over aluminium Road Train signs. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Main bumper channel is contoured to match the T608 body lines with heavy duty return panel to match mudguard contour, Dangerous Goods sign mounted to secure mounting plate welded to the upright.
